claim_summary: TS-Reasoner contributes a feedback-driven agent that decomposes natural-language time-series queries into reusable operator workflows, executes them programmatically, and revises plans using execution and prediction feedback.

claim_evidence.quote: In this work, we introduce TS-Reasoner, a domain-specialized agent designed for multi-step time series inference.

By integrating large language model (LLM) reasoning with domain-specific computational tools and error feedback loop, TS-Reasoner enables domain-informed, constraint-aware analytical workflows that combine symbolic reasoning with precise numerical analysis.
